envelope.description: Route the meta-only writers and gates.ts through writeArtifact

body.title: Route the meta-only writers and gates.ts through writeArtifact
body.summary: Move the artifact JSON writes of gates.ts (approveArtifact, rejectArtifact and ackStaleArtifact as meta-only; appendStoryToDefine as content), questions.ts, review-step findings.ts, tracker/refs.ts, bugfix/stamp.ts and the orchestrator tracker push and sync writes onto writeArtifact with the right kind, keeping markdown renders as annotated raw writes. Do not change any artifact body.
acceptanceChecks: appendStoryToDefine mints a revision and keeps the tracker block; approve, reject and ack-stale leave the revision and the body byte-identical.

For each meta-only writer (questions resolution, findings review stamp, refs patch, bugfix stamp, orchestrator tracker push and sync) the body is byte-identical before and after and the revision is unchanged.
The existing tests of these modules pass without edits.

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gates-revision.test.ts: appendStoryToDefine mints a revision, approve reject and ack-stale leave revision and body unchanged
src/workflow/__tests__/meta-only-body-unchanged.test.ts: every meta-only writer leaves the body byte-identical and the revision unchanged
